description: Component for micro-batch PostgreSQL CDC via logical replication (pgoutput).

outputs.description: Sensor run requests carrying a batch of insert/update/delete row changes

username.label: Username
username.description: PostgreSQL username with the REPLICATION attribute and SELECT on tracked tables

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the PostgreSQL password

schema.label: Schema
schema.description: Postgres schema to track table_patterns against. One schema per sensor instance.

slot_name.label: Slot Name
slot_name.description: Logical replication slot name. Created automatically (output plugin 'pgoutput') on first use if it doesn't already exist -- requires the connecting role to have the REPLICATION attribute. If a slot with this name already exists using a DIFFERENT output plugin, this sensor fails loudly via skip_reason rather than silently reading garbage.

publication_name.label: Publication Name
publication_name.description: Logical replication publication name. Created automatically if missing (FOR TABLE <resolved table_patterns>), and kept in sync every tick -- tables newly matching table_patterns are ADDed, tables that no longer match are DROPped. Creating/altering a publication requires table ownership or superuser.

table_patterns.label: Table Patterns
table_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns (e.g. 'orders', 'order_items_*') matched against bare table names within `schema`. Resolved against pg_catalog.pg_tables at the start of every tick (not cached), so a new table matching a wildcard is picked up automatically on its next tick -- no restart required.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger when changes are detected

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations

max_events_per_tick.label: Max Events Per Tick
max_events_per_tick.description: Caps how many row-change events this sensor processes in one tick. Checked by the server after each decoded transaction, so (without `streaming`, which this component never requests) a batch never ends inside an uncommitted transaction. Unset (default): no cap, processes everything currently decodable.

op_name.label: Op Name
op_name.description: Op name to key the run_config under. Emitted as `{'ops': {op_name: {'config': {...}}}}`. Defaults to 'config' for backward compat with other sensors in this registry; set to the real op/asset name if it's not literally 'config'.

source_asset_key.label: Source Asset Key
source_asset_key.description: Optional asset key to receive an AssetObservation on every tick that yields changes. Metadata includes database, schema, tables, event_count, inserts, updates, deletes, last_lsn.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Default status of the sensor (running or stopped)

emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.
emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
